definitions.explanation: The process by which a society or economy transforms from primarily agricultural to one dominated by industry and manufacturing. Used in historical, economic, and policy discussions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急速|きゅうそく}→急速：02634_kyuusoku⟧な{産業化|さんぎょうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んだ→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
{産業化|さんぎょうか}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増加|ぞうか}→増加：03329_zouka⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The urban population increased due to industrialization.

examples.japanese: ⟦{発展途上国|はってんとじょうこく}→発展途上国：22732_hattentojoukoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{産業化|さんぎょうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支援|しえん}する→支援する：25534_shiensuru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{国際的|こくさいてき}→国際的：06457_kokusaiteki⟧な⟦{枠組|わくぐ}み→枠組み：13117_wakugumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: An international framework is needed to support the industrialization of developing countries.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{産業|さんぎょう}→産業：01419_sangyou⟧ (industry) + ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ (transformation suffix). Refers to the broad socioeconomic shift toward industrial production, distinct from simply building factories.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {産業化|さんぎょうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: industrialization advances
- {産業化|さんぎょうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{推進|すいしん}する→推進する：17281_suishinsuru⟧: to promote industrialization
- ⟦{急速|きゅうそく}→急速：02634_kyuusoku⟧な{産業化|さんぎょうか}: rapid industrialization
- {産業化|さんぎょうか}⟦{以前|いぜん}→以前：01790_izen⟧: pre-industrial

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{工業化|こうぎょうか}→工業化：17504_kougyouka⟧: focuses specifically on manufacturing and factory production
- ⟦{近代化|きんだいか}→近代化：15055_kindaika⟧: modernization — broader concept that includes industrialization but also social and political reform
- ⟦{機械化|きかいか}→機械化：23913_kikaika⟧: mechanization — the adoption of machines in specific processes
